subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help-only for current pi-tui behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for `openclaw tui`?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through the editor dependency, but configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would create a new public TUI config or CLI contract.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define and test a narrow config or CLI keybinding surface for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Route Broader Composer Work Elsewhere
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to TUI inline composition and leave WebChat shortcuts, external-editor mode, and vi-mode to their existing trackers.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact issue and have the strongest history signal for the TUI launch/docs surface.
